purpose: General writing style guide for documents the plugin generates, updates and reviews: tags, headings, emphasis, structured elements, reference notation, example naming, no history sections, and terminology.
summary: Tag usage: three tag kinds, placement at heading end, and criteria A-E for MANDATORY with demotion order
Heading levels limited to four tiers
Emphasis and notation: English emphasis phrases, long-vowel omission per JIS Z 8301, bold/code/GFM alerts, no italics
Structured elements: code block language tags, list nesting, table column limits
Document reference notation for three systems, using reference-style links only, with path rules
Abstract example naming with placeholders instead of real names or concrete domains
Ban on history sections and historical narration; history belongs in CHANGELOG, git and ADR
Ban on related-documents sections, with exceptions for external URLs
Terminology: definition of a term, naming principles, bracket notation in body text, glossary rules
tasks: Writing or updating requirements, design documents and plans
Deciding whether to attach MANDATORY/CRITICAL/IMPORTANT tags
Writing cross-document references and reference links
Defining and using glossary terms in documents
Writing example snippets and rule documents
Authoring SKILL.md or agent documents that reference docs
title: 文書スタイル指針
